# HeyRanks

> HeyRanks checks a small business's website for the technical basics that Google and AI assistants rely on, explains each problem in plain English, and gives copy-paste code to fix it. Paid plans rescan every Monday and email a report with up to 5 prioritised fixes. It costs $10 one-time for 180 days (26 weekly reports), with no auto-renewal.

HeyRanks is a product of DexoSoft Solutions, based in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India. It suits local businesses (clinics, restaurants, salons, real estate, coaching), e-commerce brands, freelancers and marketing agencies.

## What each scan checks
- Search basics: HTTPS, page title and meta description length, main heading (H1), mobile viewport, XML sitemap
- AI-crawler readiness: whether robots.txt lets GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended and PerplexityBot read the site, and whether the site publishes llms.txt
- Structured data (Schema.org) and social previews (Open Graph)
- Mobile speed from Google PageSpeed Insights, shown alongside the score but not counted in it

## What customers get
- A score out of 100 and up to 5 prioritised fixes, each with copy-paste code
- Weekly email reports on paid plans, plus monthly, quarterly, half-yearly and yearly summaries
- A dashboard with score history and on-demand rescans

## Not included yet
- Checking what AI assistants say about a business, Google rankings, competitor tracking, Google Business Profile and reviews

## Key facts
- Free scan available on the homepage
- No auto-renewal; 30-day money-back guarantee
- No technical skills needed
